[[Vabbi/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic3 = [[File:Vabbi signpost.jpg|150px]] | pic3-text = Vabbi [[signpost]]. }} {{quotation|nightfall|The northern province of Vabbi is known for its great wealth and refined culture. Merchant princes pride themselves on their large estates, prosperous businesses, and patronage of the arts. Its provincial government, the [[Grand Forum of Vabb]], is a plutocracy: only the wealthiest princes in the land have the power to make laws. Their legislature is openly democratic, but secretly, a merchant with influence has more power than a councilor with one vote. Vabbian princes rule the land. Most plutocrats sponsor great festivals and celebrations to display their importance and influence. Celebrations in Vabbian estates are wonders to behold: Dancers flourish in their elegant fashions, gourmands sample cuisine, revelers consume epic quantities of alcohol, and cultured citizens enjoy great works of drama and poetry. Heroes are welcomed at these festivals, where their heroism is celebrated in songs and stories. The Vabbi are effusive in displays of self-importance, but also keenly aware of how much they depend on other [[Elona|Elonians]]. The guards of Vabbian estates watch the mountain range to the north, while citizens on the province's southern border depend on neighboring [[Kourna]]ns to keep them safe. Outside the walls of the grand estates, danger is everywhere. Raiders know secret passes through the mountains and mines, and monstrous creatures roam the landscape. Fortunately, every generation of Vabbi includes idealists who dream of adventurous journeys across Elona. New tales of adventure appear on the shelves of Vabbi's libraries each year, as actors portray new heroes on the stages of Vabbian theaters.}} [[Vabbi]] is ruled by their [[Clanmarshal (Vabbi)|clanmarshals]], also referred to as princes. The three most prominent princes are referred to as the [[Princes of Vabbi]]: [[Prince Ahmtur the Mighty]], [[Prince Bokka the Magnificent]], and [[Prince Mehtu the Wise]]. Vabbians enjoy various arts, from acting and dancing to paintings. In at least one case, actors in Vabbi have their own guild: The [[Lyssan Fools]]. Most Vabbians worship [[Lyssa]], the patron goddess of the province. The [[Vabbian military]] is not a united force, but rather guards of estates and of princes, most of which are led or affiliated with Prince Ahmtur. The lands not making up the Vabbians' estates are riddled with hostile [[plant]]s, [[harpy|Harpies]], [[Heket]]s, and other [[beast]]s. ==Towns and outposts== *[[The Kodash Bazaar]] (town) *[[Basalt Grotto]] *[[Chantry of Secrets]] *[[Honur Hill]] *[[Mihanu Township]] *[[Yahnur Market]] '''Mission outposts:''' *[[Dasha Vestibule (outpost)|Dasha Vestibule]] *[[Dzagonur Bastion (outpost)|Dzagonur Bastion]] *[[Grand Court of Sebelkeh (outpost)|Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] *[[Jennur's Horde (outpost)|Jennur's Horde]] *[[Tihark Orchard (outpost)|Tihark Orchard]] ==Missions== *[[Tihark Orchard]] *[[Dasha Vestibule]] *[[Dzagonur Bastion]] *[[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] *[[Jennur's Horde]] ==Explorable areas== *[[Bokka Amphitheatre]] *[[Forum Highlands]] *[[Garden of Seborhin]] *[[Holdings of Chokhin]] *[[Resplendent Makuun]] *[[The Hidden City of Ahdashim]] *[[The Mirror of Lyss]] *[[Vehjin Mines]] *[[Vehtendi Valley]] *[[Wilderness of Bahdza]] *[[Yatendi Canyons]] ==Landmarks== {{landmark list|Vabbi}} ==Soundtrack== *Dining in the Great Hall (only during [[Tihark Orchard]]) *Festival of Lyss *Garden of Seborhin *Path to War (only during Tihark Orchard) *Resplendent Makuun *The Makers' Song ==Gallery== ===Screenshots=== File:Nightfall screenshot 2.jpg File:Nightfall screenshot 4.jpg File:Nightfall screenshot 5.jpg File:Nightfall screenshot 7.jpg File:Nightfall screenshot 8.jpg File:Nightfall screenshot 13.jpg ===Concept art=== {{section-stub}} ==Notes== {{gw2w|Vabbi (region)|Vabbi}} *To be able to reach Vabbi, you need to follow the [[List of Nightfall missions|storyline]] or take a [[Guide to the Desolation run|long route]] through [[The Desolation]]. *The oval shaped structure north of the [[Halls of Chokhin]] is [[Ahmtur Arena]] which was not implemented in the retail version of the game.
